services.name: Picnic Shelter Area
services.desc: Park pavilion rentals are available at McKenzie Park, Butte Park, Victory Square Park and Hodge Park from April 1st through September 30th. Rentals can be reserved online or by calling the Parks & Recreation office. All rentals must be paid in full at the time of reservation. Weekdays per 4 hour session: $65 resident/$90 non-resident Weekends per 3 hour session: $65 resident/$90 non-resident Park pavilion rentals are available for small private gatherings and celebrations. Pavilions may be reserved for personal use such as birthday parties, family reunions, baby showers, graduation celebrations, and similar get-togethers. Reservations are intended for private use only unless otherwise

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Welcome to our Swim Lesson Program. While participating in swimming lessons, you will learn all the necessary swim skills to become a proficient swimmer. When registering a child for multiple sessions of swim lessons, please keep them in the same level for all sessions. Aquatic Center staff will make the changes necessary if that child is ready to move to a different level. Please read the descriptions below and choose the appropriate class. Hermiston Parks and Recreation reserves the right to remove a participant from any class if we deem it unsafe for that participant to be in that level. We cannot guarantee there will be an open spot in the appropriate class for the removed participant.

explain.meaning: A small lesson shared by two or three people.

blurb: Located in Theater Sports Park, the Good Shepherd Pickleball Complex is a premier regional facility operated by Hermiston Parks & Recreation. It features 10 individually fenced courts, including the only fully ADA-accessible wheelchair courts in the Pacific Northwest.
